run_kuhn_poker_cfr: run the CFR solver on Kuhn Poker game for 1000 iterations to compute average policy
create_cfr_solver: create a CFR solver instance initialized with a loaded OpenSpiel game object
evaluate_cfr_policy: evaluate and update the CFR policy each iteration to track game utility values
get_average_policy: get the average policy from a trained CFR solver after convergence iterations
compute_policy_value: compute expected game score values for players using a given average policy
